headline.text: Engineering graduate building data pipelines with Airflow and PySpark

bullets.text: Built an Airflow data pipeline ingesting 2 TB of flight-test data per week into a PostgreSQL warehouse
Cut a nightly batch job runtime from 6 hours to 45 minutes by rewriting it with PySpark
Wrote data-quality checks that caught 30% more sensor anomalies before analysis
Set up CI with GitHub Actions and Docker, reducing deployment time by 50%
Coursework in statistics, optimisation and machine learning
Finished in the top 5% of a time-series forecasting competition
